preconditions.description: The length of string s is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The length of string t is at least 1 and at most 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in string s is a lowercase Latin letter.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Each character in string t is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.
